sections.title: Event and Party Catering in Minneapolis, MN and the Twin Cities
body: Event and Party Catering with Minnesnowii Shave Ice will enhance any gathering. Public or private events, functions and festivals, large and small, we can serve them all.

From birthday parties and corporate rallies to the Minnesota State Fair, we can serve groups of any size. Whether you need a small booth setup, a full service cart, or a full-size trailer, we have you covered.
Submit your information on the form below, and we will reach out to firm up the details.
